breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction in the grid definition. The incomplete prompt provided a general rule for periodic domains (dx=(b-a)/Nx) and then an incorrect, specific override for this task (dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)). The agent discarded the entire confusing preamble and correctly used the definition appropriate for a periodic domain, dx=1/Nx, which aligns with the specific numerical method requirements in the ground truth.
